name: Biblical Character Study
description: Study a biblical person's life and character through the relevant passages.

sections.title: Person and passages
sections.guidance: Identify the person, name variants, and principal biblical references. Distinguish this person from others with the same name.

sections.title: Historical and biblical setting
sections.guidance: Locate the person in the biblical story, including their family, relationships, responsibilities and circumstances. Mark disputed dates or identifications as uncertain.

sections.title: Life, words and actions
sections.guidance: Trace key events chronologically where possible. Record what the text actually says, with references; do not assume the narrative gives a complete biography.

sections.title: Character and decisions
sections.guidance: Examine actions, words, strengths, weaknesses and recurring patterns. Distinguish the narrator's explicit evaluation from your own inference about motives.

sections.title: God's work and the biblical evaluation
sections.guidance: How does God act in this person's life, and how does Scripture evaluate their choices? Consider the person's place in the wider biblical story without treating every detail as exemplary.

sections.title: Main findings
sections.guidance: Summarise the person's significance with supporting passages, including uncertainties and tensions.

sections.title: Application
sections.guidance: What does Scripture teach through this life about faith, obedience, sin, grace and relationships? Apply the text rather than imitating every recorded action.

sections.title: Related figures and passages
sections.guidance: Compare relevant people or passages only where the connections illuminate the text.
